review_text: We stayed at Kolam Gandhi Serviced Apartments for 3 nights and had a most enjoyable time there throughout. The hospitality and warmth was exceptional from the time we checked in till our checkout. The reception staff were outstanding, ever willing to cheerfully serve us promptly and ensure that all our needs were met as best as was possible. Its great location, homely atmosphere, with a clean comfortable room, functional common areas and well-kept shared/private kitchenettes, as well as helpful care-takers made our stay unforgettable. The daily breakfast they served was delicious and freshly prepared. Thank you from us to all, especially the reception ladies and our caretaker.
